keyPoints: Paani teen avsthaon me milta hai — thos (barf), drav (behata paani) aur gas (adrikshya bhaap); teeno me kan wahi hain, sirf unki vyavastha badalti hai.
Barf ko garm karne par wo 0 degree Celsius par pighalkar paani banti hai; is nishchit taap ko galnank kehte hain aur pighalte samay taap badhta nahi hai.
Paani ko ubalne par 100 degree Celsius par wo bhaap me badalta hai; is taap ko kwathnank kehte hain aur ubalte samay bartan ka taap sthir rehta hai.
Bhaap ko thanda karne par wo phir paani ki chhoti boondon me badal jaati hai — ise sanghanan (condensation) kehte hain; sardi me khidki par jami boonden isi ka udaharan hain.
Jal-chakra me suraj ke taap se samudra ka paani bhaap banta hai, upar jaakar baadal banta hai aur phir barish ya barf ke roop me dharti par wapas aata hai.
Barish ka paani nadiyon-nalon se hokar phir samudra me pahunchta hai — paani kabhi khatm nahi hota, sirf ek roop se doosre roop me badalta rehta hai.
Aam galti: ketli se nikalte safed dhuein ko bhaap samajhna; asal bhaap adrishya hoti hai, jo safed dikhta hai wo hawa me thandi hokar bani chhoti paani ki boonden hain.

title: Jal ki Avsthaon ki Yatra
